name: Etapp 4 Lappudden-Ullånger
description: Lappudden to Ullånger. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Naturvatten, kallkälla near Erikskojan / Ringråberget: Natural spring/source near Erikskojan. Naturkartan describes it as water for cooking and says natural water is normally boiled before drinking/eating.
Dricksvatten, OKQ8 Ullånger: OKQ8 service point; Naturkartan water POI says bottled water is sold. Parking is behind OKQ8.
notes: Current official page and Naturkartan visible title use Etapp 4 Lappudden-Ullånger, while Naturkartan URL/GPX slug and multiple field/route-app sources use old Etapp 5 naming.
Current official sources list 14.6 km, Medel/Blå, 6-7 h. Legacy official PDF/guide materials list about 15 km, Krävande, 5-6 h.
OSM relation 19096561 starts about 216.6 m from the official GPX start at Lappudden and computes about 0.5 km shorter overall.
Official section 4 GPX end and section 5 GPX start differ by about 24.8 m near Ullånger.
Facilities lane included a lower-latitude coordinate for Nordingrå Vallen, while transit lane and a main-thread Naturkartan Hitta hit check place the bus stop around 62.93087,18.29521.
Official/Naturkartan sources list natural water near Erikskojan/Ringråberget; multiple field reports say it has been dry, muddy, or not drinkable in some years.

facilities.name: Avstickare till Körningsberget
facilities.description: Official short spur toward Körningsberget viewpoint and Tree Cube shelter. Store as side-route metadata if the POI import focuses on the Tree Cube/viewpoint itself.

facilities.name: Livsmedel, Ullånger / Coop Ullånger
facilities.description: Coop grocery at/near the stage endpoint. Naturkartan marks service and toilet; FAQ notes bottled-water sales. Bottled water purchase supported; tap refill not confirmed in the first pass. Verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Erikskojan
facilities.description: Open timber hut/rest place near Ringråberget. Official guide/FAQ describe stove, table, two sleeping benches, outside benches and a dry toilet. Field reports conflict on toilet/water currentness. Do not rely on water at the hut. Toilet presence/currentness should be verified before importing as a separate dependable amenity.

facilities.name: Körningsberget / The Tree Cube
facilities.description: ArkNat Tree Cube shelter and viewpoint at Körningsberget. Naturkartan also marks benches/fireplace/grill place at the detour destination. Fireplace use is conditional on current fire-ban status. Model as side-trip/high-value shelter/viewpoint if route-detail UI distinguishes off-main-route facilities.

facilities.name: Lappuddens Friluftscenter / Lappudden trailhead
facilities.description: Stage-start service cluster with lodging, cabins/rooms, paid camping/tent camping, toilets/showers, service water, grill places, guest swimming jetty, InfoPoint, rental outdoor gear, parking and food by arrangement. Private/commercial and seasonal or booking-dependent. Model water, toilets, showers, food and campsite as service-dependent amenities.

facilities.name: Mjälloms Tunnbröd / 1923 Tunnbröd & Deli
facilities.description: Bakery, deli/shop, café/restaurant and tourist InfoPoint in Ullånger, listed in official section/service sources. Verify opening hours seasonally.

facilities.name: Naturvatten, kallkälla near Erikskojan / Ringråberget
facilities.description: Natural spring/source near Erikskojan. Naturkartan describes it as water for cooking and says natural water is normally boiled before drinking/eating. Natural/untreated source; boil/filter. Field reports from 2008, 2016 and 2018 repeatedly reported the Erikskojan water/stream as dry or not drinkable in warm/dry periods.

facilities.name: Nordingrå Vallen bus stop
facilities.description: Official public-transport access point for Lappudden/Nordingrå access and section logistics. Not at the trailhead. Facilities lane had a conflicting lower-latitude coordinate; main-thread check resolved the Naturkartan Hitta hit coordinate to this point.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten, OKQ8 Ullånger
facilities.description: OKQ8 service point; Naturkartan water POI says bottled water is sold. Parking is behind OKQ8. Model as bottled water/service purchase, not a free public potable tap unless later verified.

facilities.name: Parkering, Ullånger
facilities.description: Free commuter/long-term parking behind OKQ8 near public transport and toilet access. Confirm overnight parking terms locally before relying on long-stay parking.

facilities.name: Ullånger Busstation
facilities.description: Bus/coach hub at the Ullånger endpoint, close to OKQ8, parking and services. Treat operator naming variants as the same practical stop cluster.

facilities.name: Ullångers Hotell & Restaurang / drinking water
facilities.description: Endpoint lodging, restaurant/café and InfoPoint. Separate Naturkartan water POI says the hotel provides drinking-water bottle refill. Water refill likely depends on hotel access/opening. Verify hours before representing food/lodging as available.
